fields.action: The following changes are proposed to the Instructions for the Treasury International Capital (TIC) Form B Reports. (1) Raise the reporting thresholds for the TIC BC, BL-1, BL-2, BQ-1, BQ-2 reports from $50 million for the Grand Total row and $25 million for any individual line item to $250 million for the Grand Total row and $100 million for any individual line item ("Exemption Levels," section I.C.4).
